newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial restructures balance sheet.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial restructures balance sheet.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said it has completed the balance sheet restructuring plan that had been initiated in December 1995.
First Industrial Chief Financial Officer Michael Havala said in a statement that the restructuring was expected to improve its 1997 funds from operations by $185,000.

"Effective 1998, these efforts should have approximately a $2.3 million positive impact on FFO, due to reduced interest rates and lower debt cost amortization," Havala said. "Moreover, the benefits multiply as we fund future growth with the company's lower capital cost alternatives."
First Industrial is a real estate investment trust that owns, manages, acquires and develops bulk warehouse and light industrial properties.
